t.BENZOPHENONE-3.agn: In the EU the limits are 6% in face, hand and lip products, 2.2% in body products and 0.5% in other products (EU 2022/1176, Annex VI entry 4); above 0.5% the label must say 'Contains Benzophenone-3'. It is on the EU priority list of potential endocrine disruptors (group A).
t.BENZOPHENONE-3.eff.0: In the SCCS assessment an effect on the hormone system could be neither proven nor ruled out; the EU limits were set on the basis of this assessment.
t.BENZOPHENONE-3.k3.0: EU priority list of potential endocrine disruptors (group A). SCCS 2021: endocrine disruption could be neither proven nor ruled out; a maximum of 2.2% in sunscreen was found to be safe, and a limit was set.
t.BENZOPHENONE-3.reg.0: EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex VI, entry 4: Permitted UV filter, with an upper limit.
t.BENZOPHENONE-3.summary: A UV filter used in sunscreens.
t.BENZOPHENONE-3.what: Absorbs UV rays; also protects the product from breaking down in light.
